# Executive Summary

This portfolio report showcases an end-to-end analytical framework for microbiome profiling using 16S rRNA and ITS amplicon sequencing data. The workflow was designed to demonstrate skills relevant to research, applied bioinformatics, data science consulting, and scientific reporting.

The framework integrates reproducible data ingestion from QIIME2 outputs, ASV filtering, alpha and beta diversity analyses, compositional profiling, differential abundance testing, and publication-ready figure generation in R. Beyond the biological results, the document highlights practical strengths valued in professional settings: modular code structure, parameterized analyses, reproducibility, data quality control, and exportable deliverables for collaborators and decision-makers.

# Professional Value Proposition

This project demonstrates the ability to:

- Build reproducible microbiome analysis pipelines in R.
- Convert raw QIIME2-derived objects into analysis-ready phyloseq workflows.
- Apply ecological statistics for alpha diversity, beta diversity, and differential abundance.
- Produce publication-quality visualizations and portfolio-ready outputs.
- Structure code and reports for collaborative science, consulting, and technical communication.

# Overview

This report presents a reproducible bioinformatics framework for microbiome analysis across soil and plant-associated microbial communities using 16S rRNA and ITS amplicon sequencing data. The workflow integrates preprocessing, ASV filtering, alpha diversity, beta diversity, relative abundance profiling, and publication-ready visualization.

The analysis is designed as a publication-oriented and portfolio-ready framework that combines reproducible data processing, ecological statistics, and scientific visualization. It generates standardized phyloseq objects, statistical tables, and publication-quality figures suitable for downstream interpretation, scientific reporting, and consulting-oriented deliverables.

# Computational Environment

All analyses were performed using R and QIIME2-derived datasets on a macOS environment.

Core tools used in this workflow include:

- QIIME2
- qiime2R
- phyloseq
- vegan
- tidyverse
- microbiome
- patchwork
- openxlsx
- rstatix
- ggplot2

# Objectives

The main objectives of this workflow are:

- To preprocess and filter ASV tables from soil and plant-associated microbiome datasets.
- To standardize bacterial and fungal datasets for downstream ecological analyses.
- To evaluate alpha diversity patterns across biological conditions and sample groups.
- To assess beta diversity and community structure using ordination and PERMANOVA.
- To generate relative abundance profiles and publication-ready figures.
- To provide a reproducible analytical framework suitable for research, reporting, and technical consulting.

# Study Design

This workflow includes:

- Soil bacterial communities analyzed using 16S rRNA amplicon data.
- Soil fungal communities analyzed using ITS amplicon data.
- Plant-associated bacterial and/or endophytic communities analyzed using comparable preprocessing and diversity analysis strategies.
- Comparative analyses across regions, compartments, and plant health conditions.

# Workflow Structure

This report is organized into the following analytical components:

1. Dataset configuration
2. Shared helper functions
3. ASV filtering and preprocessing
4. Alpha diversity analysis
5. Beta diversity analysis
6. Relative abundance profiling
7. Differential abundance analysis
8. Final exported deliverables

```{r portfolio_pipeline, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
safe_bind_rows <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!vapply(x, is.null, logical(1))]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(tibble::tibble())
  dplyr::bind_rows(x)
}

safe_save_plot <- function(filename, plot_obj, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300) {
  if (inherits(plot_obj, "ggplot")) {
    ggplot2::ggsave(filename, plot_obj, width = width, height = height, dpi = dpi)
  }
}

safe_group_count <- function(x) {
  dplyr::n_distinct(stats::na.omit(x))
}

safe_lm_pvalue <- function(df, response, group_var) {
  df2 <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[response]]), !is.na(.data[[group_var]])) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(.group = droplevels(as.factor(.data[[group_var]])))

  if (nrow(df2) < 3) return(NA_real_)
  if (safe_group_count(df2$.group) < 2) return(NA_real_)

  fml <- stats::as.formula(paste(response, "~ .group"))
  fit <- tryCatch(stats::lm(fml, data = df2), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(fit)) return(NA_real_)

  an <- tryCatch(stats::anova(fit), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(an)) return(NA_real_)

  p <- an$`Pr(>F)`[1]
  if (length(p) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  as.numeric(p)
}

make_outdirs <- function(ds_row, subdir_main) {
  outdir_root <- file.path(proj_dir, ds_row$out_root_base, ds_row$dataset_name, subdir_main)
  dir.create(outdir_root, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  for (sd in c("RDS", "Figures", "Tables", "QC", "Logs")) {
    dir.create(file.path(outdir_root, sd), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  }
  outdir_root
}

detect_sample_id_col <- function(meta_df) {
  id_candidates <- c("SampleID", "#SampleID", "sampleid", "sample_id", "sample-id")
  id_col <- id_candidates[id_candidates %in% colnames(meta_df)]
  if (length(id_col) == 0) stop("No sample ID column found in metadata.")
  id_col[1]
}

harmonize_state_var <- function(meta, state_var = "Plant_Condition") {
  meta <- as.data.frame(meta)

  if (state_var %in% names(meta)) {
    base <- meta[[state_var]]
  } else {
    candidates <- c("Health_Plant", "Condition_Plant", "Condition", "Condicion", "State", "Status")
    cand <- intersect(candidates, names(meta))
    if (length(cand) == 0) {
      meta[[state_var]] <- NA_character_
      meta[[state_var]] <- factor(meta[[state_var]], levels = c("Healthy_Plant", "Diseased_Plant"))
      return(meta)
    }
    base <- meta[[cand[1]]]
  }

  clean <- base %>%
    as.character() %>%
    stringr::str_trim() %>%
    stringr::str_to_lower()

  meta[[state_var]] <- dplyr::case_when(
    clean %in% c("healthy_plant", "healthy plant", "healthy", "h", "sana", "sano") ~ "Healthy_Plant",
    clean %in% c("diseased_plant", "diseased plant", "diseased", "d", "enferma", "enfermo") ~ "Diseased_Plant",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )

  meta[[state_var]] <- factor(meta[[state_var]], levels = c("Healthy_Plant", "Diseased_Plant"))
  meta
}

clean_tax_string <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x[x == "" | toupper(x) == "NA"] <- NA
  x <- trimws(x)
  x <- gsub("\\s+", "_", x)
  x <- gsub("^[a-z]__", "", x)
  x
}

is_alphanumeric_code <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- trimws(x)
  if (is.na(x) || x == "") return(FALSE)
  if (!grepl("^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$", x)) return(FALSE)
  if (!grepl("[0-9]", x)) return(FALSE)
  n_total <- nchar(x)
  n_dig <- nchar(gsub("[^0-9]", "", x))
  prop_d <- ifelse(n_total > 0, n_dig / n_total, 0)
  ends_digit_block <- grepl("[0-9]{2,}$", x)
  prop_d >= 0.4 || ends_digit_block
}

normalize_tax_label_strict <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)

  vapply(x, function(z) {
    if (is.na(z) || z == "") return(NA_character_)

    z <- trimws(z)

    z <- gsub("begin:math:display|end:math:display|begin:math:text|end:math:text", "", z)
    z <- gsub("\\$", "", z)
    z <- gsub("\\[|\\]|\\(|\\)", "", z)
    z <- gsub("\\s+", "_", z)
    z <- gsub("[-.]", "_", z)

    parts <- unlist(strsplit(z, "_"))
    parts <- parts[parts != ""]

    parts_clean <- parts[!(
      parts %in% c("A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "I", "II", "III", "IV", "V") |
        grepl("^[0-9]+$", parts)
    )]

    if (!length(parts_clean)) parts_clean <- parts[1]

    tolower(parts_clean[1])
  }, character(1))
}

process_tax_labels <- function(x, level = "Genus") {
  nm <- clean_tax_string(x)
  bad_pat <- paste(
    "incertae", "sedis", "unclassified", "uncultured",
    "unknown", "unassigned", "metagenome", "ambiguous",
    "norank", "no_rank", "unidentified",
    sep = "|"
  )
  nm[grepl(bad_pat, nm, ignore.case = TRUE)] <- NA
  nm[vapply(nm, is_alphanumeric_code, logical(1))] <- NA
  normalize_tax_label_strict(nm)
}

check_dataset_files <- function(ds_row) {
  feature_path <- file.path(proj_dir, ds_row$input_dir, ds_row$feature_file)
  tax_path     <- file.path(proj_dir, ds_row$input_dir, ds_row$taxonomy_file)
  tree_path    <- file.path(proj_dir, ds_row$input_dir, ds_row$tree_file)
  meta_path    <- file.path(proj_dir, ds_row$input_dir, ds_row$metadata_file)

  tibble::tibble(
    dataset_name = ds_row$dataset_name,
    feature_path = feature_path,
    taxonomy_path = tax_path,
    tree_path = tree_path,
    metadata_path = meta_path,
    feature_exists = file.exists(feature_path),
    taxonomy_exists = file.exists(tax_path),
    tree_exists = file.exists(tree_path),
    metadata_exists = file.exists(meta_path)
  )
}

load_qiime_phyloseq <- function(ds_row) {
  feature_path <- file.path(proj_dir, ds_row$input_dir, ds_row$feature_file)
  tax_path     <- file.path(proj_dir, ds_row$input_dir, ds_row$taxonomy_file)
  tree_path    <- file.path(proj_dir, ds_row$input_dir, ds_row$tree_file)
  meta_path    <- file.path(proj_dir, ds_row$input_dir, ds_row$metadata_file)

  if (!file.exists(feature_path)) stop("Feature table not found: ", feature_path)
  if (!file.exists(tax_path)) stop("Taxonomy file not found: ", tax_path)
  if (!file.exists(meta_path)) stop("Metadata file not found: ", meta_path)

  tbl_qza     <- qiime2R::read_qza(feature_path)
  feature_mat <- tbl_qza$data

  tax_qza <- qiime2R::read_qza(tax_path)
  tax_tbl <- tax_qza$data

  meta_df <- readr::read_tsv(meta_path, col_types = readr::cols())
  id_col <- detect_sample_id_col(meta_df)

  meta_df <- meta_df %>%
    dplyr::rename(SampleID = !!rlang::sym(id_col)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(SampleID = as.character(SampleID)) %>%
    tibble::column_to_rownames("SampleID")

  meta_df <- harmonize_state_var(meta_df, state_var = state_var)

  common_samples <- intersect(rownames(meta_df), colnames(feature_mat))
  if (length(common_samples) == 0) {
    stop(glue::glue("No matching samples for {ds_row$dataset_name}."))
  }

  feature_mat <- feature_mat[, common_samples, drop = FALSE]
  meta_df     <- meta_df[common_samples, , drop = FALSE]

  tax_df <- tax_tbl %>%
    tibble::as_tibble() %>%
    dplyr::rename(ASV = Feature.ID) %>%
    tidyr::separate(
      col = Taxon,
      into = c("Kingdom", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species"),
      sep = ";",
      fill = "right",
      remove = FALSE
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(Kingdom:Species, ~ stringr::str_trim(as.character(.))))

  tax_mat <- tax_df %>%
    dplyr::select(ASV, Kingdom:Species) %>%
    tibble::column_to_rownames("ASV") %>%
    as.matrix()

  common_asvs <- intersect(rownames(tax_mat), rownames(feature_mat))
  if (length(common_asvs) == 0) {
    stop(glue::glue("No matching ASVs for {ds_row$dataset_name}."))
  }

  tax_mat     <- tax_mat[common_asvs, , drop = FALSE]
  feature_mat <- feature_mat[common_asvs, , drop = FALSE]

  phy_tree_obj <- NULL
  if (file.exists(tree_path)) {
    phy_tree_obj <- qiime2R::read_qza(tree_path)$data
  }

  if (!is.null(phy_tree_obj)) {
    phyloseq::phyloseq(
      phyloseq::otu_table(feature_mat, taxa_are_rows = TRUE),
      phyloseq::tax_table(tax_mat),
      phyloseq::sample_data(meta_df),
      phyloseq::phy_tree(phy_tree_obj)
    )
  } else {
    phyloseq::phyloseq(
      phyloseq::otu_table(feature_mat, taxa_are_rows = TRUE),
      phyloseq::tax_table(tax_mat),
      phyloseq::sample_data(meta_df)
    )
  }
}

filter_taxa_by_domain <- function(ps, target_kingdom) {
  tax_tab <- as.data.frame(phyloseq::tax_table(ps))

  if (target_kingdom == "Bacteria") {
    keep_taxa_idx <- with(
      tax_tab,
      Kingdom == "Bacteria" &
        (is.na(Order)  | Order  != "Chloroplast") &
        (is.na(Family) | Family != "Mitochondria") &
        !(is.na(Phylum) | Phylum == "" | Phylum == "Unassigned")
    )
  } else if (target_kingdom == "Fungi") {
    keep_taxa_idx <- with(
      tax_tab,
      Kingdom == "Fungi" &
        !(is.na(Phylum) | Phylum == "" | Phylum == "Unassigned")
    )
  } else {
    keep_taxa_idx <- rep(TRUE, nrow(tax_tab))
  }

  keep_taxa_idx[is.na(keep_taxa_idx)] <- FALSE
  if (sum(keep_taxa_idx) == 0) return(ps)
  phyloseq::prune_taxa(keep_taxa_idx, ps)
}

pcoa_df_local <- function(dist_obj, meta_df) {
  pc <- ape::pcoa(dist_obj)
  scores <- as.data.frame(pc$vectors[, 1:2, drop = FALSE])
  colnames(scores) <- c("PCoA1", "PCoA2")
  samps <- rownames(scores)
  meta_df2 <- as.data.frame(meta_df)[samps, , drop = FALSE]
  df <- cbind(scores, meta_df2)
  df$SampleID <- samps
  var1 <- round(pc$values$Relative_eig[1] * 100, 2)
  var2 <- round(pc$values$Relative_eig[2] * 100, 2)
  list(df = df, var1 = var1, var2 = var2)
}

make_dist <- function(ps, method = c("bray", "jaccard", "unifrac_unweighted", "unifrac_weighted"), gene_type = c("16S", "ITS")) {
  method <- match.arg(method)
  gene_type <- match.arg(gene_type)

  if (method == "bray") {
    return(phyloseq::distance(ps, method = "bray"))
  }

  if (method == "jaccard") {
    return(phyloseq::distance(ps, method = "jaccard", binary = TRUE))
  }

  if (gene_type == "16S" && method %in% c("unifrac_unweighted", "unifrac_weighted")) {
    if (is.null(phyloseq::phy_tree(ps, errorIfNULL = FALSE))) {
      stop("No phylogenetic tree available.")
    }

    if (method == "unifrac_unweighted") {
      return(
        phyloseq::UniFrac(
          ps,
          weighted = FALSE,
          normalized = TRUE,
          parallel = FALSE,
          fast = TRUE
        )
      )
    }

    return(
      phyloseq::UniFrac(
        ps,
        weighted = TRUE,
        normalized = TRUE,
        parallel = FALSE,
        fast = TRUE
      )
    )
  }

  stop(glue::glue("Unsupported method {method} for gene_type {gene_type}."))
}

run_permanova <- function(dist_obj, meta_df, state_var, nperm = 999) {
  meta_df <- as.data.frame(meta_df)
  df_use <- data.frame(group = droplevels(as.factor(meta_df[[state_var]])))

  if (nrow(df_use) < 3) return(NULL)
  if (safe_group_count(df_use$group) < 2) return(NULL)

  tryCatch(
    vegan::adonis2(dist_obj ~ group, data = df_use, permutations = nperm, by = "margin"),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
}

run_betadisper <- function(dist_obj, group_vec) {
  grp <- droplevels(as.factor(group_vec))

  if (length(grp) < 3) return(NULL)
  if (safe_group_count(grp) < 2) return(NULL)

  bd <- tryCatch(vegan::betadisper(dist_obj, group = grp), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(bd)) return(NULL)

  list(
    anova = tryCatch(anova(bd), error = function(e) NULL),
    tukey = tryCatch(TukeyHSD(bd), error = function(e) NULL),
    model = bd
  )
}

global_taxon_colors <- list()

get_global_palette <- function(marker, level, taxa_vec) {
  key <- paste(marker, level, sep = "__")
  if (is.null(global_taxon_colors[[key]])) global_taxon_colors[[key]] <<- character(0)
  reg <- global_taxon_colors[[key]]

  taxa_main <- setdiff(taxa_vec, "Others")
  missing <- setdiff(taxa_main, names(reg))

  if (length(missing)) {
    base_cols <- palette_sobria_11[palette_sobria_11 != "#B0B0B0"]
    used_cols <- unname(reg)
    avail_cols <- setdiff(base_cols, used_cols)

    if (length(avail_cols) < length(missing)) {
      avail_cols <- rep(base_cols, length.out = length(missing))
    }

    new_cols <- avail_cols[seq_len(length(missing))]
    names(new_cols) <- missing
    reg <- c(reg, new_cols)
  }

  if ("Others" %in% taxa_vec) reg["Others"] <- "#B0B0B0"
  global_taxon_colors[[key]] <<- reg
  reg[taxa_vec]
}

file_check_tbl <- purrr::map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(datasets)), ~ check_dataset_files(datasets[.x, ]))
file_check_tbl

valid_datasets <- file_check_tbl %>%
  dplyr::filter(feature_exists, taxonomy_exists, metadata_exists) %>%
  dplyr::pull(dataset_name)

  dplyr::filter(dataset_name %in% valid_datasets)

if (nrow(datasets_valid) == 0) {
  filtering_summaries <- tibble::tibble(
    Status = "Input files were not found from the current working directory.",
    Recommendation = "Update YAML input paths or set proj_dir to the project root."
  )
} else {

        }

process_dataset <- function(ds_row) {
  outdir_root <- make_outdirs(ds_row, params$filtering_subdir)
  ps_raw <- load_qiime_phyloseq(ds_row)

  depth_df <- tibble::tibble(
    SampleID = phyloseq::sample_names(ps_raw),
    Reads = as.numeric(phyloseq::sample_sums(ps_raw))
  )

  p_depth <- ggplot2::ggplot(depth_df, ggplot2::aes(x = Reads)) +
    ggplot2::geom_histogram(bins = 30) +
    ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = ds_row$min_depth, linetype = "dashed") +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = glue::glue("Read depth distribution - {ds_row$dataset_name}"),
      x = "Reads per sample",
      y = "Frequency"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_bw()

  safe_save_plot(
    file.path(outdir_root, "Figures", glue::glue("DepthHistogram_{ds_row$dataset_name}.png")),
    p_depth
  )

  keep_samples <- depth_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(Reads >= ds_row$min_depth) %>%
    dplyr::pull(SampleID)

  ps_filt_samples <- if (length(keep_samples) == 0) {
    ps_raw
  } else {
    phyloseq::prune_samples(keep_samples, ps_raw)
  }

  if (phyloseq::nsamples(ps_filt_samples) == 0) {
    stop(glue::glue("No samples left after depth filtering for {ds_row$dataset_name}."))
  }

  ps_filt <- filter_taxa_by_domain(ps_filt_samples, ds_row$target_kingdom)

  if (phyloseq::ntaxa(ps_filt) == 0) {
    stop(glue::glue("No taxa left after taxonomic filtering for {ds_row$dataset_name}."))
  }

  ps_counts <- ps_filt
  rare_depth_use <- min(ds_row$rarefaction_depth, min(phyloseq::sample_sums(ps_filt)))

  ps_rarefied <- tryCatch(
    phyloseq::rarefy_even_depth(
      ps_filt,
      sample.size = rare_depth_use,
      rngseed = 123,
      replace = FALSE,
      verbose = TRUE
    ),
    error = function(e) ps_filt
  )

  ps_rel <- phyloseq::transform_sample_counts(ps_filt, function(x) x / sum(x))

  summary_tbl <- tibble::tibble(
    Dataset = ds_row$dataset_name,
    System = ds_row$system,
    Region = ds_row$Region,
    Marker = ds_row$Marker,
    Domain = ds_row$Domain,
    ASV_initial = phyloseq::ntaxa(ps_raw),
    ASV_post_samples = phyloseq::ntaxa(ps_filt_samples),
    ASV_post_taxonomy = phyloseq::ntaxa(ps_filt),
    Samples_initial = phyloseq::nsamples(ps_raw),
    Samples_filtered = phyloseq::nsamples(ps_filt),
    Min_depth = ds_row$min_depth,
    Rarefaction_depth = ds_row$rarefaction_depth,
    Rarefaction_used = rare_depth_use
  )

  saveRDS(summary_tbl, file.path(outdir_root, "QC", glue::glue("filtering_summary_{ds_row$dataset_name}.rds")))
  readr::write_csv(summary_tbl, file.path(outdir_root, "QC", glue::glue("filtering_summary_{ds_row$dataset_name}.csv")))

  saveRDS(ps_counts,   file.path(outdir_root, "RDS", glue::glue("ps_counts_{ds_row$dataset_name}.rds")))
  saveRDS(ps_rarefied, file.path(outdir_root, "RDS", glue::glue("ps_rarefied_{ds_row$dataset_name}.rds")))
  saveRDS(ps_rel,      file.path(outdir_root, "RDS", glue::glue("ps_rel_{ds_row$dataset_name}.rds")))

  summary_tbl
}

filtering_summaries <- purrr::map(

    ds <- datasets_valid[i, ]
    tryCatch(

      error = function(e) {

      }
    )

) %>%

# ============================================================
analysis_info <- purrr::map(seq_len(nrow(datasets_valid)), function(i) {
  ds_row <- datasets_valid[i, ]
  out_root <- make_outdirs(ds_row, params$analysis_subdir)
  ps_rar <- load_ps_object(ds_row, "ps_rarefied")
  if (is.null(ps_rar)) return(NULL)

  list(
    meta = ds_row,
    out_root = out_root,
    ps_rarefied = ps_rar
  )
})

names(analysis_info) <- datasets_valid$dataset_name
analysis_info <- analysis_info[!vapply(analysis_info, is.null, logical(1))]

alpha_all <- purrr::map(names(analysis_info), function(nm) {
  info <- analysis_info[[nm]]
  ps <- info$ps_rarefied

  alpha <- phyloseq::estimate_richness(ps, measures = c("Observed", "Shannon", "Chao1"))
  sd <- data.frame(phyloseq::sample_data(ps), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

  df <- cbind(alpha, sd)
  df$SampleID <- rownames(alpha)
  df$Dataset <- nm
  df$System <- info$meta$system
  df$Region <- info$meta$Region
  df$Marker <- info$meta$Marker
  df$Domain <- info$meta$Domain
  df
}) %>%
  safe_bind_rows()

if (nrow(alpha_all) > 0 && "Plant_Condition" %in% colnames(alpha_all)) {
  alpha_all <- alpha_all %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Plant_Condition_raw = as.character(Plant_Condition),
      Plant_Condition_clean = Plant_Condition_raw %>%
        stringr::str_trim() %>%
        stringr::str_to_lower(),
      Plant_Condition = dplyr::case_when(
        stringr::str_detect(Plant_Condition_clean, "healthy|sana|sano") ~ "Healthy_Plant",
        stringr::str_detect(Plant_Condition_clean, "diseased|enferma|enfermo") ~ "Diseased_Plant",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      Plant_Condition = factor(
        Plant_Condition,
        levels = c("Healthy_Plant", "Diseased_Plant")
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(-Plant_Condition_raw, -Plant_Condition_clean)
}

if (nrow(alpha_all) > 0 && "Plant_Condition" %in% colnames(alpha_all)) {
  alpha_all %>% dplyr::count(System, Dataset, Plant_Condition)
}

col_PC <- c("Diseased_Plant" = "#F8766D", "Healthy_Plant" = "#00BFC4")
plots_alpha_shannon_ds <- list()
plots_alpha_chao_ds <- list()
alpha_stats_all <- list()

if (nrow(alpha_all) > 0 && "Plant_Condition" %in% colnames(alpha_all)) {
  for (nm in unique(alpha_all$Dataset)) {
    df <- alpha_all %>%
      dplyr::filter(Dataset == nm, !is.na(Plant_Condition))

    if (nrow(df) == 0) next
    if (safe_group_count(df$Plant_Condition) < 2) next

    region_lab <- unique(df$Region)[1]
    marker_lab <- unique(df$Marker)[1]
    system_lab <- unique(df$System)[1]

    pval_sh <- safe_lm_pvalue(df, "Shannon", "Plant_Condition")
    pval_ch <- safe_lm_pvalue(df, "Chao1", "Plant_Condition")

    sig_sh <- ifelse(is.na(pval_sh), "NA", ifelse(pval_sh < 0.05, "**", "NS"))
    sig_ch <- ifelse(is.na(pval_ch), "NA", ifelse(pval_ch < 0.05, "**", "NS"))

    fit_sh <- tryCatch(stats::lm(Shannon ~ Plant_Condition, data = df), error = function(e) NULL)
    fit_ch <- tryCatch(stats::lm(Chao1 ~ Plant_Condition, data = df), error = function(e) NULL)

    if (!is.null(fit_sh)) {
      alpha_stats_all[[paste0(nm, "_Shannon")]] <- broom::tidy(stats::anova(fit_sh)) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(Dataset = nm, Index = "Shannon")
    }

    if (!is.null(fit_ch)) {
      alpha_stats_all[[paste0(nm, "_Chao1")]] <- broom::tidy(stats::anova(fit_ch)) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(Dataset = nm, Index = "Chao1")
    }

    ymax_sh <- max(df$Shannon, na.rm = TRUE)
    ymax_ch <- max(df$Chao1, na.rm = TRUE)

    p_sh <- ggplot2::ggplot(df, ggplot2::aes(x = Plant_Condition, y = Shannon, fill = Plant_Condition)) +
      ggplot2::geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8, outlier.shape = NA) +
      ggplot2::geom_jitter(
        ggplot2::aes(color = Plant_Condition),
        width = 0.15,
        size = 2,
        alpha = 0.7,
        show.legend = FALSE
      ) +
      ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = col_PC, drop = FALSE) +
      ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = col_PC, drop = FALSE) +
      ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = ymax_sh * 1.05, label = sig_sh, size = 6) +
      ggplot2::labs(
        title = glue::glue("Alpha diversity - Shannon index ({system_lab}, {region_lab}, {marker_lab})"),
        x = "Plant condition",
        y = "Shannon index"
      ) +
      ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
      ggplot2::theme(
        axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "none"
      )

    p_ch <- ggplot2::ggplot(df, ggplot2::aes(x = Plant_Condition, y = Chao1, fill = Plant_Condition)) +
      ggplot2::geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8, outlier.shape = NA) +
      ggplot2::geom_jitter(
        ggplot2::aes(color = Plant_Condition),
        width = 0.15,
        size = 2,
        alpha = 0.7,
        show.legend = FALSE
      ) +
      ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = col_PC, drop = FALSE) +
      ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = col_PC, drop = FALSE) +
      ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = ymax_ch * 1.05, label = sig_ch, size = 6) +
      ggplot2::labs(
        title = glue::glue("Alpha diversity - Chao1 index ({system_lab}, {region_lab}, {marker_lab})"),
        x = "Plant condition",
        y = "Chao1 richness"
      ) +
      ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
      ggplot2::theme(
        axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "none"
      )

    plots_alpha_shannon_ds[[nm]] <- p_sh
    plots_alpha_chao_ds[[nm]] <- p_ch

    info <- analysis_info[[nm]]
    safe_save_plot(file.path(info$out_root, "Figures", glue::glue("Alpha_Shannon_{nm}.pdf")), p_sh, 6, 4)
    safe_save_plot(file.path(info$out_root, "Figures", glue::glue("Alpha_Chao1_{nm}.pdf")), p_ch, 6, 4)
  }
}

alpha_stats_all <- safe_bind_rows(alpha_stats_all)
alpha_stats_all

plot_alpha_multipanel <- function(df, marker_label, index_label, title_label, y_label, out_name, root_dir) {
  df_use <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(Marker == marker_label, !is.na(Plant_Condition))

  if (nrow(df_use) == 0) return(NULL)

  ann <- df_use %>%
    dplyr::group_by(System, Region) %>%
    dplyr::group_modify(function(.x, .y) {
      p_val <- safe_lm_pvalue(.x, index_label, "Plant_Condition")
      y_val <- max(.x[[index_label]], na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05
      tibble::tibble(
        y = y_val,
        p = p_val,
        SignifCode = ifelse(is.na(p_val), "NA", ifelse(p_val < 0.05, "**", "NS"))
      )
    }) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()

  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(
    df_use,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = Plant_Condition,
      y = .data[[index_label]],
      fill = Plant_Condition
    )
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8, outlier.shape = NA) +
    ggplot2::geom_jitter(
      ggplot2::aes(color = Plant_Condition),
      width = 0.15,
      size = 2,
      alpha = 0.7,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    ggplot2::facet_grid(System ~ Region, scales = "free_y") +
    ggplot2::geom_text(
      data = ann,
      ggplot2::aes(x = 1.5, y = y, label = SignifCode),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 5
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = col_PC, drop = FALSE) +
    ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = col_PC, drop = FALSE) +
    ggplot2::labs(title = title_label, x = NULL, y = y_label) +
    ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      legend.position = "none"
    )

  dir.create(root_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  safe_save_plot(file.path(root_dir, out_name), p, 9, 6)
  p
}

# ============================================================
# 5) BETA DIVERSITY ANALYSIS
# ============================================================
beta_summary <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(datasets_valid))) {
  ds <- datasets_valid[i, ]
  analysis_root <- make_outdirs(ds, params$analysis_subdir)
  fig_dir <- file.path(analysis_root, "Figures")
  tab_dir <- file.path(analysis_root, "Tables")
  rds_dir <- file.path(analysis_root, "RDS")

  ps <- load_ps_object(ds, "ps_rarefied")
  if (is.null(ps)) next

  meta <- as.data.frame(phyloseq::sample_data(ps)) %>%
    harmonize_state_var(state_var = state_var)

  keep <- !is.na(meta[[state_var]])
  ps <- phyloseq::prune_samples(keep, ps)

  if (phyloseq::nsamples(ps) < 3) next

  meta <- as.data.frame(phyloseq::sample_data(ps))
  meta[[state_var]] <- droplevels(as.factor(meta[[state_var]]))

  if (safe_group_count(meta[[state_var]]) < 2) next

  phyloseq::sample_data(ps) <- phyloseq::sample_data(meta)

  dist_methods <- if (ds$Marker == "16S") {
    c("bray", "jaccard", "unifrac_unweighted", "unifrac_weighted")
  } else {
    c("bray", "jaccard")
  }

  perm_list <- list()
  bd_anova_list <- list()
  bd_full_list <- list()

  for (dm in dist_methods) {
    dist_obj <- tryCatch(
      make_dist(ps, method = dm, gene_type = ds$Marker),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )

    if (is.null(dist_obj)) next

    ord <- pcoa_df_local(dist_obj, meta_df = meta)
    df_ord <- ord$df

    p <- ggplot2::ggplot(df_ord, ggplot2::aes(x = PCoA1, y = PCoA2, color = .data[[state_var]])) +
      ggplot2::geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.9) +
      ggplot2::labs(
        title = glue::glue("{ds$dataset_name} - {dm}"),
        x = glue::glue("PCoA1 ({ord$var1}%)"),
        y = glue::glue("PCoA2 ({ord$var2}%)"),
        color = "Plant condition"
      ) +
      ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = col_PC, drop = TRUE) +
      ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
      ggplot2::theme(panel.grid = ggplot2::element_blank(), legend.position = "right")

    safe_save_plot(file.path(fig_dir, glue::glue("PCoA_{ds$dataset_name}_{dm}.pdf")), p, 7, 5)
    safe_save_plot(file.path(fig_dir, glue::glue("PCoA_{ds$dataset_name}_{dm}.png")), p, 7, 5)

    perm_res <- run_permanova(dist_obj, meta_df = meta, state_var = state_var, nperm = 999)
    bd_res <- run_betadisper(dist_obj, meta[[state_var]])

    if (!is.null(perm_res)) perm_list[[dm]] <- perm_res
    if (!is.null(bd_res) && !is.null(bd_res$anova)) bd_anova_list[[dm]] <- bd_res$anova
    if (!is.null(bd_res)) bd_full_list[[dm]] <- bd_res
  }

  if (length(perm_list) > 0) {
    wb_perm <- openxlsx::createWorkbook()
    for (nm in names(perm_list)) {
      sh <- substr(glue::glue("{ds$dataset_name}_{nm}"), 1, 31)
      openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb_perm, sh)
      openxlsx::writeData(
        wb_perm,
        sh,
        as.data.frame(perm_list[[nm]]) %>%
          tibble::rownames_to_column("Term")
      )
    }
    openxlsx::saveWorkbook(
      wb_perm,
      file.path(tab_dir, glue::glue("PERMANOVA_results_{ds$dataset_name}.xlsx")),
      overwrite = TRUE
    )
  }

  if (length(bd_anova_list) > 0) {
    wb_bd <- openxlsx::createWorkbook()
    for (nm in names(bd_anova_list)) {
      sh <- substr(glue::glue("{ds$dataset_name}_{nm}"), 1, 31)
      openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb_bd, sh)
      openxlsx::writeData(
        wb_bd,
        sh,
        as.data.frame(bd_anova_list[[nm]]) %>%
          tibble::rownames_to_column("Term")
      )
    }
    openxlsx::saveWorkbook(
      wb_bd,
      file.path(tab_dir, glue::glue("Betadisper_ANOVA_{ds$dataset_name}.xlsx")),
      overwrite = TRUE
    )
  }

  if (length(bd_full_list) > 0) {
    saveRDS(bd_full_list, file.path(rds_dir, glue::glue("Betadisper_full_lists_{ds$dataset_name}.rds")))
  }

  beta_summary[[ds$dataset_name]] <- tibble::tibble(
    Dataset = ds$dataset_name,
    System = ds$system,
    Region = ds$Region,
    Marker = ds$Marker,
    Domain = ds$Domain,
    Distances_run = paste(names(perm_list), collapse = ", ")
  )
}

beta_summary <- safe_bind_rows(beta_summary)
beta_summary

beta_bray_all <- purrr::map(seq_len(nrow(datasets_valid)), function(i) {
  ds <- datasets_valid[i, ]
  ps <- load_ps_object(ds, "ps_rarefied")
  if (is.null(ps)) return(NULL)

  meta <- as.data.frame(phyloseq::sample_data(ps)) %>%
    harmonize_state_var(state_var = state_var)

  keep <- !is.na(meta[[state_var]])
  ps <- phyloseq::prune_samples(keep, ps)

  if (phyloseq::nsamples(ps) < 3) return(NULL)

  meta <- as.data.frame(phyloseq::sample_data(ps))
  if (safe_group_count(meta[[state_var]]) < 2) return(NULL)

  phyloseq::sample_data(ps) <- phyloseq::sample_data(meta)

  dist_obj <- tryCatch(
    make_dist(ps, method = "bray", gene_type = ds$Marker),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(dist_obj)) return(NULL)

      Domain = ds$Domain,
      Plant_Condition = .data[[state_var]],
      Var_PC1 = ord$var1,

}) %>%

plot_beta_bray_marker <- function(df_beta, marker_label, out_root, out_name) {
  df_marker <- df_beta %>%
    dplyr::filter(Marker == marker_label, !is.na(Plant_Condition))

  if (nrow(df_marker) == 0) return(NULL)

  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(df_marker, ggplot2::aes(x = PCoA1, y = PCoA2, color = Plant_Condition)) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.9) +
    ggplot2::facet_grid(System ~ Region) +
    ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = col_PC, drop = TRUE) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = glue::glue("PCoA Bray-Curtis - {marker_label} datasets"),
      x = "PCoA1",
      y = "PCoA2",
      color = "Plant condition"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"),
      panel.grid.major = ggplot2::element_line(color = "grey90"),
      panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank()
    )

  dir.create(out_root, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  safe_save_plot(file.path(out_root, out_name), p, 10, 6)
  p
}

}

# ============================================================
# 6) RELATIVE ABUNDANCE PROFILING
# ============================================================
find_ps_counts <- function(ds_row) {
  file.path(
    proj_dir,
    ds_row$out_root_base,
    ds_row$dataset_name,
    params$filtering_subdir,
    "RDS",
    glue::glue("ps_counts_{ds_row$dataset_name}.rds")
  )
}

make_stacked_bar <- function(ds_row, level = "Order", top_n = params$top_n) {
  ps_path <- find_ps_counts(ds_row)
  if (!file.exists(ps_path)) return(NULL)

  ps0 <- tryCatch(readRDS(ps_path), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(ps0)) return(NULL)

  sd0 <- tryCatch(
    as(phyloseq::sample_data(ps0), "data.frame") %>%
      harmonize_state_var(state_var = state_var),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(sd0) || nrow(sd0) == 0) return(NULL)

  phyloseq::sample_data(ps0) <- phyloseq::sample_data(sd0)

  keep <- rownames(sd0)[!is.na(sd0[[state_var]])]
  if (length(keep) == 0) return(NULL)

  ps_sub <- phyloseq::prune_samples(keep, ps0)
  ps_sub <- phyloseq::prune_taxa(phyloseq::taxa_sums(ps_sub) > 0, ps_sub)

  if (phyloseq::nsamples(ps_sub) < 2 || phyloseq::ntaxa(ps_sub) == 0) return(NULL)

  tax_tab0 <- tryCatch(as.matrix(phyloseq::tax_table(ps_sub)), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(tax_tab0)) return(NULL)
  if (!level %in% colnames(tax_tab0)) return(NULL)

  ps_rel <- tryCatch(microbiome::transform(ps_sub, "compositional"), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(ps_rel)) return(NULL)

  psl <- tryCatch(
    phyloseq::tax_glom(ps_rel, taxrank = level, NArm = TRUE),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(psl) || phyloseq::ntaxa(psl) == 0) return(NULL)

  OT <- tryCatch(as(phyloseq::otu_table(psl), "matrix"), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(OT)) return(NULL)
  if (!phyloseq::taxa_are_rows(psl)) OT <- t(OT)

  tax_mat <- tryCatch(as.matrix(phyloseq::tax_table(psl)), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(tax_mat)) return(NULL)
  if (!level %in% colnames(tax_mat)) return(NULL)

  tax_vec <- tax_mat[, level]
  nm_clean <- process_tax_labels(tax_vec, level = level) %>%
    stringr::str_to_title()

  df_lv <- as.data.frame(OT) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("Taxon_raw") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Taxon = nm_clean) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(Taxon), Taxon != "") %>%
    dplyr::select(-Taxon_raw) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = -Taxon,
      names_to = "SampleID",
      values_to = "RelAbund"
    )

  if (nrow(df_lv) == 0) return(NULL)

  sd_ra <- tryCatch(
    as(phyloseq::sample_data(psl), "data.frame") %>%
      tibble::rownames_to_column("SampleID") %>%
      harmonize_state_var(state_var = state_var),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(sd_ra) || nrow(sd_ra) == 0) return(NULL)

  df_lv <- df_lv %>%
    dplyr::left_join(sd_ra[, c("SampleID", state_var)], by = "SampleID") %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[state_var]]))

  if (nrow(df_lv) == 0) return(NULL)

  top_taxa <- df_lv %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Taxon) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(mean_rel = mean(RelAbund, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(mean_rel)) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = top_n) %>%
    dplyr::pull(Taxon)

  if (length(top_taxa) == 0) return(NULL)

  df_bar <- df_lv %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Taxon_group = dplyr::if_else(Taxon %in% top_taxa, Taxon, "Others")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data[[state_var]], Taxon_group) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(RelAbund = mean(RelAbund, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  if (nrow(df_bar) == 0) return(NULL)

  df_bar[[state_var]] <- factor(
    df_bar[[state_var]],
    levels = c("Healthy_Plant", "Diseased_Plant")
  )

  cond_levels <- c("Healthy_Plant", "Diseased_Plant")

  if (!any(df_bar$Taxon_group == "Others")) {
    df_bar <- dplyr::bind_rows(
      df_bar,
      tibble::tibble(
        !!rlang::sym(state_var) := cond_levels,
        Taxon_group = "Others",
        RelAbund = 0
      )
    )
  }

  df_bar <- df_bar %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data[[state_var]]) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      total_rel = sum(RelAbund, na.rm = TRUE),
      RelAbund = dplyr::if_else(total_rel > 0, RelAbund / total_rel, 0)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::select(-total_rel)

  tax_order <- df_bar %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Taxon_group) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(mean_rel = mean(RelAbund, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(Taxon_group != "Others"), dplyr::desc(mean_rel)) %>%
    dplyr::pull(Taxon_group)

  if ("Others" %in% tax_order) {
    tax_order <- c(setdiff(tax_order, "Others"), "Others")
  }

  df_bar$Taxon_group <- factor(df_bar$Taxon_group, levels = tax_order)

  levs_tax <- levels(df_bar$Taxon_group)
  cols_use <- get_global_palette(ds_row$Marker, level, levs_tax)
  if ("Others" %in% levs_tax) cols_use["Others"] <- "#B0B0B0"

  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(
    df_bar,
    ggplot2::aes(x = .data[[state_var]], y = RelAbund, fill = Taxon_group)
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.75) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = cols_use, drop = FALSE, breaks = levs_tax) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = glue::glue("{ds_row$system} - {ds_row$Region} - {ds_row$Marker} - {level}"),
      x = NULL,
      y = "Relative abundance (%)",
      fill = level
    ) +
    theme_pub(base_size = 11)

  list(plot = p, table = df_bar)
}

relabund_tables <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(datasets_valid))) {
  ds <- datasets_valid[i, ]

  for (lev in params$tax_levels) {
    res <- tryCatch(
      make_stacked_bar(ds, level = lev, top_n = params$top_n),
      error = function(e) {
        message("Relative abundance skipped for ", ds$dataset_name, " / ", lev, ": ", e$message)
        NULL
      }
    )

    if (is.null(res)) next

    out_dir <- file.path(
      proj_dir,
      ds$out_root_base,
      "Multipanels",
      params$analysis_subdir,
      "01_Individual"
    )

    dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

    safe_save_plot(
      file.path(out_dir, glue::glue("StackedBar_{ds$dataset_name}_{lev}.pdf")),
      res$plot,
      7.5, 5.2
    )

    safe_save_plot(
      file.path(out_dir, glue::glue("StackedBar_{ds$dataset_name}_{lev}.png")),
      res$plot,
      7.5, 5.2
    )

    relabund_tables[[paste(ds$dataset_name, lev, sep = "_")]] <- res$table %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        Dataset = ds$dataset_name,
        System = ds$system,
        Region = ds$Region,
        Marker = ds$Marker,
        Domain = ds$Domain,
        Level = lev,
        RelAbund_percent = RelAbund * 100
      )
  }
}

relabund_tables <- safe_bind_rows(relabund_tables)
relabund_tables

if (nrow(relabund_tables) > 0) {

    overwrite = TRUE
  )
}

# ============================================================
# 7) DIFFERENTIAL ABUNDANCE ANALYSIS
# ============================================================
da_results_all <- tibble::tibble()

if (requireNamespace("ANCOMBC", quietly = TRUE)) {
  library(ANCOMBC)

  datasets_da <- tibble::tribble(
    ~dataset_name,       ~Region,     ~Marker, ~Domain,    ~out_root_base,
    "Caldas_Endo16S",    "Caldas",    "16S",   "Bacteria", params$da_out_root_16S,
    "Risaralda_Endo16S", "Risaralda", "16S",   "Bacteria", params$da_out_root_16S
  )

  build_ps_counts_path <- function(ds_row) {
    file.path(
      proj_dir,
      ds_row$out_root_base,
      ds_row$dataset_name,
      params$filtering_subdir,
      "RDS",
      glue::glue("ps_counts_{ds_row$dataset_name}.rds")
    )
  }

  standardize_condition <- function(x) {
    x <- trimws(as.character(x))
    x <- stringr::str_to_lower(x)
    dplyr::case_when(
      x %in% c("healthy", "healthy_plant", "healthy plant", "sano", "sana") ~ "Healthy_Plant",
      x %in% c("diseased", "diseased_plant", "diseased plant", "enfermo", "enferma") ~ "Diseased_Plant",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  }

  harmonize_metadata_da <- function(ps, condition_col = "Condition", tissue_col = "Plant_Tissues") {
    meta <- as.data.frame(phyloseq::sample_data(ps))

    if (!"Plant_Condition" %in% colnames(meta)) {
      if (condition_col %in% colnames(meta)) {
        meta$Plant_Condition <- standardize_condition(meta[[condition_col]])
      } else {
        stop("No Plant_Condition or Condition column found in metadata.")
      }
    } else {
      meta$Plant_Condition <- standardize_condition(meta$Plant_Condition)
    }

    if (!tissue_col %in% colnames(meta)) {
      stop(glue::glue("Column '{tissue_col}' not found in metadata."))
    }

    meta$Plant_Condition <- factor(
      meta$Plant_Condition,
      levels = c("Healthy_Plant", "Diseased_Plant")
    )
    meta$Plant_Tissues <- as.factor(meta[[tissue_col]])
    meta$State <- meta$Plant_Condition

    phyloseq::sample_data(ps) <- phyloseq::sample_data(meta)
    ps
  }

  refresh_phyloseq <- function(ps_in) {
    otu <- as(phyloseq::otu_table(ps_in), "matrix")
    if (!phyloseq::taxa_are_rows(ps_in)) otu <- t(otu)
    otu <- round(otu)
    mode(otu) <- "numeric"

    meta <- phyloseq::sample_data(ps_in)
    tax  <- phyloseq::tax_table(ps_in, errorIfNULL = FALSE)
    tree <- phyloseq::phy_tree(ps_in, errorIfNULL = FALSE)

    args <- list(
      phyloseq::otu_table(otu, taxa_are_rows = TRUE),
      phyloseq::sample_data(as(meta, "data.frame"))
    )

    if (!is.null(tax))  args <- c(args, list(phyloseq::tax_table(as.matrix(tax))))
    if (!is.null(tree)) args <- c(args, list(tree))

    do.call(phyloseq::phyloseq, args)
  }

  run_ancombc2_tissue <- function(ps, tissue_name, tax_level = "Genus", alpha = 0.05, p_adj = "fdr") {
    meta <- as.data.frame(phyloseq::sample_data(ps))
    keep_samples <- rownames(meta)[meta$Plant_Tissues == tissue_name & !is.na(meta$Plant_Condition)]

    ps_sub <- phyloseq::prune_samples(keep_samples, ps)
    ps_sub <- phyloseq::prune_samples(phyloseq::sample_sums(ps_sub) > 0, ps_sub)

    if (phyloseq::nsamples(ps_sub) < 3 || phyloseq::ntaxa(ps_sub) == 0) return(NULL)
    if (safe_group_count(as.data.frame(phyloseq::sample_data(ps_sub))$State) < 2) return(NULL)

    ps_glom <- phyloseq::tax_glom(ps_sub, taxrank = tax_level, NArm = TRUE)
    ps_glom <- phyloseq::prune_taxa(phyloseq::taxa_sums(ps_glom) > 0, ps_glom)
    if (phyloseq::ntaxa(ps_glom) == 0) return(NULL)

    ps_glom <- refresh_phyloseq(ps_glom)

    fit <- tryCatch(
      ANCOMBC::ancombc2(
        data         = ps_glom,
        fix_formula  = "State",
        group        = NULL,
        p_adj_method = p_adj,
        prv_cut      = 0,
        lib_cut      = 0,
        struc_zero   = FALSE,
        neg_lb       = FALSE,
        alpha        = alpha,
        global       = FALSE,
        pairwise     = FALSE,
        dunnet       = FALSE,
        trend        = FALSE,
        verbose      = FALSE
      ),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )

    if (is.null(fit)) return(NULL)

    res <- fit$res
    if (is.null(res) || !nrow(res)) return(NULL)

    lfc_cols <- grep("^lfc_", colnames(res), value = TRUE)
    if (!length(lfc_cols)) return(NULL)

    lfc_col <- lfc_cols[1]
    suffix  <- sub("^lfc_", "", lfc_col)
    q_col   <- paste0("q_", suffix)

    tax_mat <- as.matrix(phyloseq::tax_table(ps_glom))
    tax_labels <- if (tax_level %in% colnames(tax_mat)) {
      as.character(tax_mat[, tax_level])
    } else {
      rownames(tax_mat)
    }

    tax_labels[is.na(tax_labels) | tax_labels == ""] <- paste0("Unclassified_", tax_level)

    tibble::tibble(
      Taxon  = tax_labels,
      lfc    = res[[lfc_col]],
      q      = if (q_col %in% colnames(res)) res[[q_col]] else NA_real_,
      Tissue = tissue_name,
      Level  = tax_level
    ) %>%
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(lfc)) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(q)
  }

  tissue_order <- c("Corm", "Leaf", "Mid_Rib")
  tax_levels_da <- c("Order", "Family", params$da_tax_level)
  da_results <- list()

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(datasets_da))) {
    ds <- datasets_da[i, ]
    ps_path <- build_ps_counts_path(ds)
    if (!file.exists(ps_path)) next

    ps <- readRDS(ps_path)
    ps <- tryCatch(harmonize_metadata_da(ps), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(ps)) next

    for (lev in tax_levels_da) {
      for (tiss in tissue_order) {
        res <- tryCatch(
          run_ancombc2_tissue(
            ps = ps,
            tissue_name = tiss,
            tax_level = lev,
            alpha = params$da_alpha,
            p_adj = params$da_p_adjust
          ),
          error = function(e) NULL
        )

        if (!is.null(res) && nrow(res) > 0) {
          res$Dataset <- ds$dataset_name
          res$Region  <- ds$Region
          da_results[[paste(ds$dataset_name, lev, tiss, sep = "_")]] <- res
        }
      }
    }
  }

  da_results_all <- safe_bind_rows(da_results)
  da_results_all

  if (nrow(da_results_all) > 0) {
    out_xlsx <- file.path(proj_dir, "DifferentialAbundance_ANCOMBC2_Endophytes16S.xlsx")
    openxlsx::write.xlsx(split(da_results_all, da_results_all$Level), out_xlsx, overwrite = TRUE)

    plot_da_top_taxa <- function(df, dataset_name, tissue_name, tax_level = "Genus", top_n = 12) {
      df_plot <- df %>%
        dplyr::filter(
          Dataset == dataset_name,
          Tissue == tissue_name,
          Level == tax_level
        ) %>%
        dplyr::filter(!is.na(q)) %>%
        dplyr::arrange(q) %>%
        dplyr::slice_head(n = top_n) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          Enrichment = dplyr::case_when(
            lfc > 0  ~ "Diseased-enriched",
            lfc < 0  ~ "Healthy-enriched",
            TRUE     ~ "Neutral"
          ),
          Taxon = factor(Taxon, levels = rev(unique(Taxon)))
        )

      if (nrow(df_plot) == 0) {
        return(ggplot2::ggplot() + ggplot2::theme_void() + ggplot2::ggtitle("No significant taxa available"))
      }

      ggplot2::ggplot(df_plot, ggplot2::aes(x = Taxon, y = lfc, fill = Enrichment)) +
        ggplot2::geom_col(width = 0.8) +
        ggplot2::coord_flip() +
        ggplot2::labs(
          title = glue::glue("Differential abundance ({dataset_name} - {tissue_name}, {tax_level})"),
          x = NULL,
          y = "Log fold change"
        ) +
        ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
          values = c(
            "Healthy-enriched"  = "#00BFC4",
            "Diseased-enriched" = "#F8766D",
            "Neutral"           = "grey70"
          )
        ) +
        ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
        ggplot2::theme(
          legend.title = ggplot2::element_blank(),
          plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold")
        )
    }

    p_da_example <- plot_da_top_taxa(
      da_results_all,
      dataset_name = "Caldas_Endo16S",
      tissue_name = "Corm",
      tax_level = "Genus",
      top_n = params$da_top_n_plot
    )

    print(p_da_example)
  }
} else {
  message("Package ANCOMBC not installed. Differential abundance section skipped.")
}

beta_summary
relabund_tables
da_results_all
```

# Differential Abundance Notes

- Differential abundance was assessed using ANCOM-BC2, suitable for compositional microbiome count data.
- The comparison shown here focuses on Healthy_Plant vs Diseased_Plant.
- Analyses were performed separately by plant tissue to preserve biological interpretability.
- Taxa were evaluated at Order, Family, and Genus levels.
- Output tables and figures are suitable for manuscript preparation, technical reporting, and consulting portfolios.

# Final Deliverables

This workflow generates outputs suitable for research projects, manuscripts, and consulting reports, including:

- Filtered and rarefied phyloseq objects
- Alpha diversity plots and ANOVA tables
- Beta diversity PCoA plots and PERMANOVA tables
- Betadisper outputs
- Relative abundance figures
- Publication-ready PDF multipanels
- Excel summary tables for downstream reporting

# Final Remarks

This report documents a complete and reproducible microbiome analysis framework integrating QIIME2-derived inputs with R-based ecological and statistical analyses across soil and plant-associated datasets. The workflow is suitable for bacterial and fungal community studies based on 16S rRNA and ITS amplicon sequencing and provides outputs that can be used for scientific manuscripts, technical consulting portfolios, and collaborative microbiome projects.

The framework combines standardized preprocessing, alpha and beta diversity analysis, ecological statistics, relative abundance profiling, and publication-ready figure generation in a modular structure that can be extended to additional microbiome datasets with minimal modification.
